text: The shift lead noted a few words on gate calls after a tricky moment. Incident Report: Gate Call Review and Companion Animal Transfer. During routine outbound checks at Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk received a set of gate calls that needed quick review because one passenger believed the companion animal clearance had already been confirmed, while the boarding team still needed a final check before handoff. The case was handled in real time with the welcome team and the desk in close contact, and the traveler was kept informed in calm, plain language. After the first review, the paperwork was found to be in order, but the pet carrier label needed a fresh check against the passenger record, so the desk asked for the item to be brought back to the counter for a brief recheck. The staff member on duty confirmed the details, matched the travel notes, and reassured the passenger that the process was moving normally. No distress was seen in the animal, and the traveler remained cooperative throughout. Once the review was complete, the boarding path was reopened and the companion animal was cleared to continue with the journey. The welcome team then supported the final handoff and kept the boarding area orderly. Follow-up steps included a reminder to the desk team to repeat the label and record check earlier in the flow, to reduce delay at the gate, and to share any similar note with the next shift. The incident was contained without further issue, and service continued as expected. Companion Animal Travel Desk
